product_one_liner.value: DesignArena lets creators make websites, games, images, videos, presentations, and apps by trying and comparing leading AI models to find what works best for their project.

pricing_page.notes: The homepage navigation/footer has no pricing link, and a current review reports that no public pricing page exists.

named_customers.notes: The G2 listing shows zero reviews and no named customers.

employee_band.notes: A profile reports 12 employees as of November 2, 2026; other company-size estimates differ, so this band is an estimate.

eng_blog.notes: The official blog index includes multiple technical posts on implementation and agent harnesses; author job titles are not shown.

public_docs.notes: The public developer documentation includes an introduction, quickstart, and multiple API reference pages.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: The parent company behind DesignArena lists a live Member of Technical Staff, ML Engineer position.

model_provider.value: Multiple providers, including OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, xAI, and Mistral; no single default provider is specified.
model_provider.notes: The company documents a provider-agnostic agent harness and identifies these supported model providers.

compliance_certs.notes: The security page says its infrastructure is hosted on cloud providers with these certifications; it does not expressly say Design Arena itself holds them.

last_funding.notes: The company announced the $7.9 million seed on August 3, 2026.

raised_18mo.notes: Its $7.9 million seed was announced August 3, 2026, within the 18-month window.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: The open roles listed are engineering roles and an open application; none is an SDR, BDR, or account executive position.

launched_6mo.notes: DesignArena introduced PDF Arena on November 2, 2026, within the six-month window.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: The small listed leadership team consists of founders whose profiles date their Design Arena roles to July 2025, before the 12-month window; no departure announcement was found.

crm_stack_signal.notes: The public API documentation names no CRM or sales/marketing system.
